scientific_integrity: Finite-state Markov chain tree theorem and exact stationarity identities prove the displayed fixed-length asymptotics; finite symbolic/numerical checker assertions are supplementary, not an all-length proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed integer length L at least 2, positive fixed alpha and beta, unit right hopping and local resets only to a vacant injection site. No uniform error in growing L or inference about global resets. Publication priority not independently certified.
title: Universal strong-reset current and the two-site anomaly in an open exclusion chain
